obligations.statement: Acquire the actual DOI archive bytes and verify their relationship to the publication-tag artifacts.
Install the pinned Lean/Lake/mathlib environment and obtain the first compiled milestone.
Prove equality of the raw unnormalized transvectant definition and the exported original table.
Prove bilinearity, alternation and Jacobi for arbitrary coordinates and install the actual LieRing structure.
Formally validate the 88-node generation DAG, including unit denominators and all 31 basis targets.
Prove the classification-free flag-rigidity argument for every bracket-preserving linear equivalence.
Prove the classification-free infinitesimal flag-rigidity argument for every derivation.
Formalize perfectness, centre and relevant bracket filtration; establish the needed independent inner derivations.
Prove the adapted unimodular basis, weights, A, L, common rational space, and quotient coordinate equivalence.
Prove every additive finite-quotient endomorphism is linear over the relevant quotient ring.
Treat arbitrary finite-quotient automorphism and derivation representatives, prove bracket-error estimates and reduction into 1+J or J.
Prove integral exponential/logarithm inverse bijections and exact congruence preservation for the two lattices.
Prove the tensor-action factorization and integral invertibility of U(X), with no loss of congruence precision.
Derive K inside Lean from the actual Lie bracket and identify its full derivation kernel.
Develop and prove sound the local Smith certificate checker, including legitimate unit inverses and exact p-power divisions.
Kernel-check acceptance of the actual 931-pivot certificate for the actual 14415 by 961 matrix.
Prove the exact rational rank upper bound using 30 independent inner derivations and transport to L.
Prove the complete kernel has cardinality 1009^(30*1689+1689).
Prove the lower-central containments and nilpotency class at most 846.
Define and prove the finite BCH group structure, without assuming associativity or Lazard.
Prove both directions of full group-automorphism versus full Lie-ring-automorphism correspondence.
Prove the two unconditional cardinality theorems for the actual paper group.
Prove the standard-definition existence statement, prime, odd-order and nontriviality facts.
Fresh full dependency build, actual elaborated statements and axiom reports, fresh kernel recheck and statement-fidelity review.
